correctness.rationale: The square-free graph condition guarantees two distinct neighborhood simplices share at most one vertex. For each center and root, pairing every non-root face of size >=2 with its rooted coface in decreasing cardinality is a valid elementary collapse because no different center contains that face. The residual star edges are unique, connected by alternating graph walks, and have count e-|B| on A, thus cycle rank e-|V|+1; similarly on B. The statement holds for leaves, trees and isolated K2 (connected no isolates). The proof is mathematically valid and not dependent on the reported 1501 small enumerations.
